dedupe_keys.name: diputacion provincial de barcelona road datasets

description: Diputación Provincial de Barcelona: road datasets is a collection of datasets listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Diputación Provincial de Barcelona. Coverage: Diputación Provincial de Barcelona. The listing groups 5 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about road; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Mapa del grafo de la red local de carreteras de la Diputación de Barce; Mapa de la red local de carreteras de la Diputación de Barcelona; Mapa de los tramos de la red local de carreteras con la información as; Mapa de los tramos de aforo con la información asociada a las estacion. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.ca). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
